### 1. Round-trip profitability bug — CONFIRMED UNPATCHED

`WMATIC→USDC` 20K still signals `🟢 EXECUTE` with `netProfitAdj: $61.68` on the Sep 15 scan. The one-way quote comparison has not been corrected. Live round-trip verification (block #93,831,144, two independent RPCs) confirmed **net loss of -$99.55** at 20K and **negative at every size from 200 to 20K WMATIC**.

| Size (WMATIC) | QS→USDC | SS→WMATIC back | Gross WMATIC | Net $ |

| 5,000 | 478.86 | 4,914.68 | -85.32 | -$8.48 |

### 2. Phantom guard nondeterminism — CONFIRMED

Sep 14 scan (block #93,771,163): **all 5 pairs flagged `🟢 EXECUTE`** including 28.9% and 37.7% spreads.
Sep 15 scan (block #93,828,825): **5 of 6 pairs correctly flagged `👻 PHANTOM%`** — the guard works most of the time but not deterministically.

### 3. `isPhantom` / `phantom` struct fields always `false` — CONFIRMED (6/6 records)

All 6 Sep 15 records have `isPhantom: false` and `phantom: false`, including the 5 labeled `👻 PHANTOM%` in the `signal` field.

| WETH→USDC | 10 | 👻 PHANTOM% | false | false |
| WETH→USDC | 15 | 👻 PHANTOM% | false | false |
| WETH→WMATIC | 10 | 👻 PHANTOM% | false | false |
| WMATIC→USDC | 20,000 | 🟢 EXECUTE | false | false |
| WMATIC→USDC | 30,000 | 👻 PHANTOM% | false | false |

**New pair size**: `WMATIC→USDC` 30,000 (5.1% spread) appears for the first time — phantom correctly detected in `signal` but `phantom` field is `false`.

### 4. Scanner inactivity gaps — CONFIRMED

Missing daily log files: **Sep 5, 10, 13, 15**. Today's scan was appended to `opportunities-2026-09-14.jsonl` instead of creating a new `opportunities-2026-09-15.jsonl`.
